title: Simulating User Diversity in Task-Oriented Dialogue Systems using Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Analyzing the frequency distribution of generated user ages and desired degree programs to identify model skewness and failure to generate diverse age groups.

Comparing the distribution of generated user genders against real-world university demographics and analyzing the correlation between assigned gender and study interests to detect stereotypical alignments (e.g., assigning more technical subjects to male users).

Mapping generated user nationalities and cross-referencing the users' geographic regions with their assigned study interests to identify stereotypical associations (e.g., assigning IT/Artificial Intelligence interests predominantly to Asian and German users, while assigning sustainability interests to others).
